feature: LMS React Frontend — Phase 1 service #10: Vite + React 19 SPA, Keycloak-js auth, TanStack Query+Router, Zustand, shadcn/ui + Tailwind v4, single apiClient through YARP gateway.

tasks.title: Scaffold Vite + React 19 + TS project, deps, Tailwind v4, shadcn init
tasks.spec: Create `frontend/` at repo root via `npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts`. Install deps per contracts.md §1: react@19, @tanstack/react-query@5, @tanstack/react-router@1, keycloak-js@25, axios, zustand@5, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, zod, tailwindcss@4, @tailwindcss/vite, lucide-react. Dev: vitest, @testing-library/react, eslint, prettier. Configure `vite.config.ts` with @vitejs/plugin-react + @tailwindcss/vite + alias `@`→./src and port 5173. Configure tsconfig path alias. Init shadcn (`npx shadcn@latest init`). Copy `silent-check-sso.html` template into `public/`. Create `frontend/.env.example` with the four VITE_* vars from contracts.md §8. Append `frontend/node_modules/`, `frontend/.env.local`, `frontend/dist/` to repo `.gitignore`. Replace stub `App.tsx` with empty placeholder; do NOT wire routes yet.

tasks.title: Core lib: keycloak singleton + apiClient + publicApiClient + queryClient + env
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §2 and §6. Create `src/lib/env.ts` typing the four VITE_* vars. Create `src/lib/keycloak.ts` exporting Keycloak singleton. Create `src/lib/api-client.ts` exporting BOTH `apiClient` (with request interceptor that calls `keycloak.updateToken(30)` then attaches Bearer; response interceptor: 401 → `keycloak.login()`) AND `publicApiClient` (no interceptors). Create `src/lib/query-client.ts` exporting a `QueryClient` with `staleTime: 60_000`, `retry: 1`. Create `src/types/index.ts` with the verbatim type set from docs/frontend.md plus contracts.md §4 additions (ErrorResponse, SessionStartedDto, AnswerDto, AssessmentResultDto, AttemptSummaryDto, CertificateSummary, CertificateDetail, VerificationResult). NO React components in this task.

tasks.title: Auth slice: useAuth, useCurrentUser, ProtectedRoute, main.tsx Keycloak.init
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §2. Implement `features/auth/hooks/useAuth.ts` (returns the locked shape — isAuthenticated, token, userId, tenantId, roles, hasRole, login, logout). Implement `features/auth/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts` (queries `/api/identity/me` with apiClient — returns profile DTO; key `['identity','me']`). Implement `features/auth/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx` per locked behavior (unauth → login; missing role → AccessDenied; else children). Implement `components/feedback/AccessDenied.tsx`. Implement `src/app/main.tsx` to call `keycloak.init({ onLoad:'check-sso', silentCheckSsoRedirectUri: origin+'/silent-check-sso.html', pkceMethod:'S256' })` then `ReactDOM.createRoot` rendering `<Providers>`. Implement `src/app/providers.tsx` wrapping `QueryClientProvider` + `RouterProvider` (router placeholder import — actual tree comes in T4). Bind `keycloak.onTokenExpired` to refresh.

tasks.title: Router tree, RootLayout shell, base layout components, shadcn primitives
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §3. Create `src/app/router.tsx` with declarative TanStack Router tree (rootRoute + children for every path in §3 — components imported lazily where pages don't exist yet, use placeholder components for not-yet-built pages). Create `src/app/RootLayout.tsx` (Header + main `<Outlet/>` + footer). Create `components/layout/{Header,NavBar,UserMenu}.tsx` (UserMenu calls `useAuth().logout`). Create `components/layout/ui-store.ts` (Zustand: sidebarOpen, theme, toast queue per contracts.md §5). Create `components/feedback/{Skeleton,ErrorBanner,EmptyState}.tsx`. Add shadcn primitives by running `npx shadcn@latest add button card input label dialog dropdown-menu select tabs toast skeleton progress badge`. NO feature pages yet — placeholder pages for catalogue/dashboard/etc.

tasks.title: Feature: courses (hooks + catalogue + detail + editor + create form)
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §4. Implement `features/courses/api/use-courses.ts` exposing courseKeys + useCourses + useCourse + useCourseSyllabus + useCreateCourse + useUpdateCourse + usePublishCourse with mutation-success invalidations as documented. Implement components: CourseCard, CourseSyllabus, CreateCourseForm (React Hook Form + Zod schema from docs/frontend.md), PublishButton. Implement pages: CataloguePage (paginated grid), CourseDetailPage (header + syllabus + EnrollButton placeholder slot), CourseEditorPage (instructor — wraps CreateCourseForm in edit mode). Wire into router (replace placeholders in T4 router tree).

tasks.title: Feature: enrollment + progress (hooks + EnrollButton + MyCoursesPage + DashboardPage)
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §4. Implement `features/enrollment/api/use-enrollments.ts` (useMyEnrollments, useEnroll, useCancelEnrollment). EnrollButton.tsx: on 409 PAYMENT_REQUIRED, show shadcn dialog 'Payment required (Phase 2)'; on 201 navigate to course detail. MyCoursesPage.tsx: lists enrollments joined with progress. Implement `features/progress/api/use-progress.ts` (useMyProgress, useCourseProgress, useCompleteLesson; useCompleteLesson onSuccess invalidates progress + enrollment keys). ProgressBar.tsx component (uses shadcn Progress). DashboardPage.tsx: dashboard combining MyCoursesPage + recent activity (uses both hooks). Hook into router replacing placeholders.

tasks.title: Feature: content (hooks + VideoPlayer + PdfViewer + ScormPlayer + UploadDialog + LessonPage + player-store)
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §4 + §5. Implement `features/content/api/use-content.ts` (useContentStream, useReportContentProgress, useUploadContent — three-step upload: init → S3 PUT → process). Implement player-store.ts Zustand (currentLessonId, isPlaying, volume, playbackRate, lastReportedAt). VideoPlayer.tsx per docs/frontend.md (heartbeat 30s via useReportContentProgress; honors resumePositionSeconds). PdfViewer.tsx (native iframe to signed URL — see Open Decision #5). ScormPlayer.tsx per docs/frontend.md sandbox+postMessage bridge calling useCompleteLesson on `cmi.core.lesson_status=passed|completed`. UploadDialog.tsx (instructor) using useUploadContent + RHF + Zod (file required, contentType enum, lessonId required). LessonPage.tsx switches player by contentType. ContentUploadPage.tsx wraps UploadDialog. Wire router.

tasks.title: Feature: assessment (hooks + QuizRunner + QuestionCard + ResultPanel + QuizPage + quiz-store)
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §4 + §5. Implement `features/assessment/api/use-assessments.ts` (useStartAssessmentSession, useSubmitAssessment, useMyAttempts). quiz-store.ts Zustand (sessionId, currentQuestionIndex, draftAnswers Record, startedAt, expiresAt; setAnswer, next, prev, reset). QuestionCard.tsx renders MCQ / multi-select / free-text per QuestionDto.type. QuizRunner.tsx orchestrates: fetch session via mutation onSubmit of useStartAssessmentSession, render QuestionCards stepper, on submit dispatch useSubmitAssessment with draftAnswers. ResultPanel.tsx shows AssessmentResultDto + retry CTA when `passed=false`. QuizPage.tsx wraps QuizRunner with ProtectedRoute. Wire router.

tasks.title: Feature: certificate (hooks + CertificateCard + MyCertificates + public VerifyPage)
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §4. Implement `features/certificate/api/use-certificates.ts` (useMyCertificates uses apiClient; useCertificate uses apiClient; useVerifyCertificate uses publicApiClient — no auth header). CertificateCard.tsx (issue date, course title, download PDF link, verify URL with copy button). MyCertificatesPage.tsx (auth required). VerifyPage.tsx (public; reads $code route param; shows valid/invalid + cert details). Wire router.

tasks.title: LandingPage + NotFoundPage + final router wiring + production build smoke
tasks.spec: Implement public LandingPage (hero + 'Browse courses' CTA → /courses) and NotFoundPage. Replace any remaining placeholder pages in router.tsx. Run `npm run build` and ensure dist/ produces with no errors. Run `npx tsc --noEmit`. Run `npm run lint` (configure ESLint flat config in T1; if missing, add minimal config here).

tasks.title: AppHost: register frontend npm app + verify gateway CORS + Keycloak realm lms-spa client
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §7. Edit src/LMS.AppHost/Program.cs: replace the commented frontend block with active `AddNpmApp('frontend', '../../frontend', 'dev')` + WithReference(gateway) + WaitFor(gateway) + four VITE_* env vars + WithHttpEndpoint(5173) + WithExternalHttpEndpoints. Verify gateway CORS allowed origins includes http://localhost:5173 — if missing, add to gateway appsettings.json `Cors:AllowedOrigins`. Verify keycloak realm file (locate at repo `keycloak/lms-realm.json` or `src/LMS.AppHost/keycloak/lms-realm.json`) has `lms-spa` public client with redirectUris ['http://localhost:5173/*'] and webOrigins ['http://localhost:5173'] and PKCE S256; if missing, add per docs/frontend.md §Keycloak client registration. Add a gateway integration test `tests/LMS.IntegrationTests/Gateway/CorsTests.cs` asserting `OPTIONS /api/courses` from Origin http://localhost:5173 returns 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoed and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials true.

tasks.title: Vitest unit tests for apiClient, useAuth, ProtectedRoute, query hooks, Zod schemas
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §9 unit list. Configure vitest in frontend/vite.config.ts (test env: jsdom). Add `frontend/tests/setup.ts`. Write tests: (1) apiClient interceptors — token attach + 401 redirect (mock keycloak module). (2) publicApiClient — no Authorization header attached. (3) useAuth shape (mock keycloak global). (4) ProtectedRoute — three branches. (5) For each feature hook (use-courses, use-enrollments, use-content, use-progress, use-assessments, use-certificates) one happy-path test verifying query key shape + URL called (use msw or axios-mock-adapter). (6) Zod schemas reject invalid + accept valid (CreateCourseForm, UploadDialog).

tasks.title: Architecture + component tests (axios uniqueness, no localStorage tokens, no inline style, RTL behavior)
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md §9 architecture + component lists. Architecture vitest tests under `frontend/tests/architecture/`: (a) only `src/lib/api-client.ts` contains `axios.create(`; grep all .ts/.tsx files. (b) no file under src/ writes to localStorage/sessionStorage with a token-shaped key (regex over file contents). (c) no `style={{` in src/**/*.tsx. (d) no `apiClient.(get|post|put|delete|patch)` outside `src/features/**/api/**` and `src/lib/**` (mutations may be invoked elsewhere via the hook return). Component tests (React Testing Library): CourseCard renders title + enroll CTA; EnrollButton handles 409 PAYMENT_REQUIRED branch (shows dialog); QuizRunner reads draftAnswers from Zustand; VideoPlayer fires heartbeat at 30s with vi.useFakeTimers; ProtectedRoute role-mismatch → AccessDenied.

tasks.title: Frontend security audit: token storage, header forgery, JWT lifecycle, CSP
tasks.spec: Audit scope: frontend/. Specific checks: (1) keycloak.token NEVER written to localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB — confirmed by static analysis + manual code review. (2) apiClient is the only axios instance; refresh-before-send via updateToken(30) is in place; 401 → login. (3) `silent-check-sso.html` is empty/minimal and served same-origin. (4) No client-side computation of tenant_id — always read from Keycloak token claims (verify no hardcoded tenant in src). (5) ScormPlayer iframe sandbox flags include allow-scripts only as required; postMessage origin check is `event.origin !== window.location.origin`. (6) No secret-bearing env var leaks in client bundle (search dist for any non-VITE_* secret pattern). (7) CSP header recommendation captured for production hosting in T15 docs (advisory). (8) verify route uses publicApiClient (no Bearer) and is guarded behind no role. Produce findings report; HIGH severity blocks T15.

tasks.title: Final review against contracts.md + frontend absolute rules
tasks.spec: Run code-reviewer on T1–T14 changes. Mandatory checks: (1) NO JWT/refresh-token in localStorage/sessionStorage; (2) every API call goes through `apiClient` (or `publicApiClient` for /verify only); (3) NO direct fetch in components — only via TanStack Query hooks; (4) tenantId never hardcoded — only from useAuth; (5) every protected route uses <ProtectedRoute>; (6) all form state via React Hook Form (no controlled useState forms); (7) no inline styles — Tailwind only; (8) Aspire AddNpmApp present and uses gateway endpoint env var; (9) gateway CORS includes 5173; (10) keycloak realm has lms-spa client; (11) all 6 feature slices present per contracts.md §1; (12) all 13 API hooks per contracts.md §4 present with locked signatures; (13) Zustand stores limited to UI state per §5. Address all HIGH from T14. Block merge on contract drift.
acceptance: cd src/frontend && npm run build && npx vitest run

tasks.spec: Update docs/frontend.md to match shipped reality: confirm declarative router style, list final shadcn primitives shipped, note Tailwind v4, document the publicApiClient pattern for /verify, document the EnrollButton 409 flow. Add an 'Operations' section: (a) running locally via Aspire (frontend launches on :5173), (b) running standalone via `cd frontend && npm run dev`, (c) Keycloak realm import path, (d) production hosting note (Phase 2 deferred), (e) feature-flag-style toggles for vi/i18n (Phase 2). Update README root with 'frontend' run instructions.
